sanskrit_verse: पितृद्रव्याविरोधेन यद् अन्यत् स्वयम् अर्जितम् । मैत्रमौद्वाहिकं चैव दायादानां न तद् भवेत् ॥
transliteration: pitṛdravyāvirodhena yad anyat svayam arjitam / maitramaudvāhikaṃ caiva dāyādānāṃ na tad bhavet //
sph_interpretive_translation: Property acquired independently and in accordance with paternal estate, including gifts made at the time of marriage, shall not be subject to inheritance by sons.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the autonomous acquisition of wealth through conscious effort aligned with Dharma.
Causation is established through individual action unconnected to ancestral assets.
Capacity-based responsibility recognizes self-generated ownership free from hereditary claims.
Restoration logic ensures rightful retention of earned property without external encumbrance.
Consciousness alignment upholds the sovereignty of personal endeavor as a sacred entitlement.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual acquires property through independent means AND such acquisition does not conflict with paternal estate THEN such property is excluded from succession rights of descendants.
IF a gift is conferred during marriage AND it originates from self-acquired resources THEN it remains exclusively owned by the recipient and is non-transferable to heirs.
IF a claimant asserts inheritance over self-earned assets THEN verification must occur via documented proof of origin AND absence of paternal contradiction.
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes concerning inheritance, the Supreme Court must recognize that property obtained autonomously—especially when documented and unlinked to ancestral holdings—is beyond the scope of filial succession. Legal precedence should affirm the inviolability of individually earned assets against compulsory distribution.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Ownership derived through conscious labor aligns with pramāṇa-based truth; hence, its exclusion from inheritance reflects natural justice (nyaya). There is no fault to punish, only clarity to establish regarding the boundaries of lawful possession.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate documentation validation process to confirm source of acquisition.
Facilitate family council sessions to reaffirm understanding of ownership boundaries.
Implement legal recognition protocols ensuring title remains with the earner.
Realign familial expectations through dharmic education on individual economic sovereignty.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism as the sole Source of Sanatan Dharma: Wealth acquired through righteous self-effort stands beyond hereditary division. Thus is Dharma restored, reality affirmed as non-punitive, and consciousness upheld as the ultimate arbiter of ownership.
